items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was basically Gerry and Gil’s band... I think Miles approved of their suggestions... I think Gerry talked him out of that in terms of the balance that my sound would add to the ensemble.

ctx.x: Yeah. He took his pipe out and passed it over and I said that I had tried it but I hadn’t really experienced it, so I took probably one “poke” and then we went down and at some point I had a sixteen bar solo on some tune and it was suddenly a very long distance to the microphone and I got there just in time, I might have been late actually. When I came back Gerry was hysterical, I remember that distinctly. I don’t know if anyone else was.
And you hadn’t played a note?
